# Sello PK

> Sello is Pakistan's premier automotive marketplace and live vehicle auction platform.

Sello connects car buyers and sellers across Pakistan, providing verified vehicle listings, real-time live car auctions, AI-assisted price estimation, certified condition reports, and comprehensive automotive guides.

## Core Services
- [Home](https://sello.pk/): Pakistan's verified automotive marketplace and auction hub.
- [Car Listings](https://sello.pk/listings): Search and filter verified used cars by make, model, year, and city.
- [Live Vehicle Auctions](https://sello.pk/auctions): Bid in real-time on verified cars with authentic inspection sheets.
- [Car Price Estimator](https://sello.pk/car-estimator): AI-driven used car valuation and price trends across Pakistan.
- [Automotive Blog](https://sello.pk/blog): Expert car reviews, driving licensing guides, vehicle maintenance, and market news.
- [About Sello](https://sello.pk/about): Learn about the Sello platform, trust and safety standards, and team.
- [Contact Support](https://sello.pk/contact): Customer service, dealer verification, and user inquiries.

## Technical & Discovery
- [Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD)](https://sello.pk/.well-known/ard.json): Machine-readable resource manifest for AI agents.
- [Sitemap](https://sello.pk/sitemap.xml): Complete XML index of marketplace listings and content pages.
